question: ________ are a kind of waste disposal system of the cell. They help to keep the cell clean by digesting any foreign materials as well as worn-out cell organelles.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lysosomes.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lysosomes **are a kind of waste disposal system of the cell.
 
• They help to keep the** cell clean by digesting any foreign materials as well as worn-out cell organelles.**
